youtube.title: Why Airplane Food Tastes So Bland ✈️ #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
At cruising altitude, cabin air is very dry, the pressure is lower, and the engines create constant loud noise. Together these dull the sense of smell and reduce how sweet and salty foods taste. The meal itself has not changed; your senses have.

Subscribe to The Hidden Why for a new why every day.
